name: ruflo-x-gateway
description: Coordinate AI-agent swarms through signed federation messages, channels, and work claims. The remote Claude connector exposes a directory-safe Streamable HTTP MCP surface with OAuth-protected publishing and five ruv:// reference resources.

guard.title: Secret guard
guard.description: Refuse swarm messages that hold a secret.

adminToken.title: Gateway admin token
adminToken.description: Admin token for a gateway you run yourself; it enables write and admin routes. Kept in the credential store, never in settings; RUFLO_ADMIN_TOKEN still works when this is empty.
